title: LIFT: Scoped Constraints for Evaluating and Training Instruction Following
abstract: arXiv:2610.28819v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Common instruction following (IF) benchmarks, such as IFEval, evaluate the ability of language models (LMs) to follow simple constraints that can easily be verified programmatically. These same constraints, in turn, are used as reward signals for reinforcement learning. This design may lead to reward hacking of constraints, pushing models away from the main task. Recent attempts to address this resulted in benchmarks with richer constraints, but required expert labor, remained closed-access, and cannot be easily extended. We present Lift-Bench, an IF benchmark that asks a model to draft a document given a topic and a structured outline. Constraints are scoped to certain document sections, providing finer control over constraint density. Lift-Bench includes both verifiable and judged constraints, as well as a training counterpart, Lift-Train. translated_title: LIFT：用于评估和训练指令遵循的范围限定约束
translated_abstract: 常见的指令遵循（IF）基准（如IFEval）评估语言模型（LM）遵循可通过程序轻松验证的简单约束的能力。而这些相同的约束又被用作强化学习的奖励信号。这种设计可能导致模型对约束进行奖励破解，使模型偏离主要任务。近期为解决这一问题所做的尝试产生了包含更丰富约束的基准，但这些基准需要专家人力投入、保持封闭访问、且难以扩展。我们提出了Lift-Bench，这是一个指令遵循基准，要求模型根据给定的主题和结构化大纲起草文档。约束被限定在特定的文档部分，从而对约束密度提供更精细的控制。Lift-Bench既包含可验证的约束，也包含需评审的约束，同时还提供了配套的训练集Lift-Train。重要的是，Lift-Bench同时提供主任务和指令遵循约束，缓解了（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出Lift-Bench指令遵循基准，通过将约束限定在文档特定部分并同时提供主任务约束与指令约束，缓解了强化学习中的奖励破解问题，并配套了可用于训练的Lift-Train数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Lift-Bench, an instruction-following benchmark that scopes constraints to specific document sections and combines main-task constraints with instruction-following constraints to mitigate reward hacking, along with a training counterpart Lift-Train.
